# Introduction

ANCOVA analyses using all data (Eng + Fr speakers). These analyses compare 
Week 16 outcomes between treatment groups while adjusting for baseline values, 
site, and covariates (age [centered], nonverbal IQ [centered], and sex). 
Additionally, ELS outcomes also adjusted for total number of utterances.

## Summary statistics

{{< include _demographics.qmd >}}

## Table 1: Demographics for ELS ANCOVA Subjects

The following tables present baseline demographic characteristics limited to 
subjects with complete ANCOVA data for ELS outcomes, stratified by:
1. All subjects
2. Age 6-11 (with p-values for Met vs. Placebo within this age group)
3. Age 12+ (with p-values for Met vs. Placebo within this age group)

{{< include _demographics_ancova_els.qmd >}}

## Table 2: Demographics for Secondary Outcome ANCOVA Subjects

The following tables present baseline demographic characteristics limited to 
subjects with complete ANCOVA data for at least one secondary outcome, 
stratified by:
1. All subjects
2. Age 6-11 (with p-values for Met vs. Placebo within this age group)
3. Age 12+ (with p-values for Met vs. Placebo within this age group)

{{< include _demographics_ancova_secondary.qmd >}}

## Primary ANCOVA Results Table

```{r}
#| label: primary-ancova-table
#| include: false

# Primary outcomes table (ELS only)
primary_ancova_summary <- els_ancova_summary
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-primary-ancova
#| tbl-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "Primary ANCOVA Results - ELS Outcomes. Adjusted ANCOVA results showing LS means (95% CI) for baseline and 16-week change, and between-group difference in changes. {data_caption}")

primary_ancova_ft <- primary_ancova_summary |>
  dplyr::select(
    Outcome, n_p, baseline_p, baseline_p_ci, p_change, p_change_ci,
    n_m, baseline_m, baseline_m_ci, m_change, m_change_ci,
    baseline_contrast_mean, baseline_contrast_ci,
    contrast_mean, contrast_ci, contrast_p
  ) |> 
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::set_header_labels(
    Outcome = "ELS Outcome",
    n_p = "N",
    baseline_p = "LS Mean",
    baseline_p_ci = "95% CI",
    p_change = "LS Mean",
    p_change_ci = "95% CI",
    n_m = "N",
    baseline_m = "LS Mean",
    baseline_m_ci = "95% CI",
    m_change = "LS Mean",
    m_change_ci = "95% CI",
    baseline_contrast_mean = "LS Mean",
    baseline_contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    contrast_mean = "LS Mean",
    contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    contrast_p = "p-value"
  ) |>
  flextable::add_header_row(
    values = c("", "",
               "Baseline", "16-week Change", "", 
               rep(c("Baseline", "16-week Change"), 2)),
    colwidths = c(1, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3)
  ) |> 
  flextable::add_header_row(
    values = c("", "Placebo", "Metformin", "Metformin vs. Placebo"),
    colwidths = c(1, 5, 5, 5)
  ) |>
  flextable::add_header_row(
    values = c("", "Within-Group Comparison", "Between-Group Comparison"),
    colwidths = c(1, 10, 5)
  ) |> 
  flextable::theme_vanilla() |>
  flextable::align(i = 4, align = "left", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(i = c(1, 2, 3), align = "center", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all") |>
  flextable::vline(j = c(1, 6, 11), part = "all") |>
  flextable::vline(
    j = c(2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 13, 15),
    part = "header",
    border = officer::fp_border(color = "black", width = 1)
  ) |>
  flextable::vline(
    j = c(2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 13, 15),
    part = "body",
    border = officer::fp_border(color = "black", width = 1)
  ) |>
   flextable::hline(
     i = c(1, 3),
     part = "header",
     border = officer::fp_border(color = "black", width = 1)
   ) |>
   flextable::hline(
     i = nrow(primary_ancova_summary),
     part = "body",
     border = officer::fp_border(color = "black", width = 1)
  ) |> 
  flextable::autofit()

primary_ancova_ft
```

## Secondary ANCOVA Results Table

```{r}
#| label: secondary-ancova-table
#| include: false

# Filter Vineland to Raw Score and Standard Score outcomes
vabs_raw_stnd_only <- vabs_ancova_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(Outcome, "Raw Score") | 
                  stringr::str_detect(Outcome, "Standard Score"))

# Combine all secondary outcomes (with filtered Vineland)
secondary_ancova_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    bmi_ancova_summary |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "BMI",
        .before = 1
      ),
    abc_ancova_summary |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "ABC",
        .before = 1
      ),
    adams_ancova_summary |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "ADAMS",
        .before = 1
      ),
    pql_ancova_summary |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "Peds QL",
        .before = 1
      ),
    cshq_ancova_summary |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "CSHQ",
        .before = 1
      ),
    snap_ancova_summary |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "SNAP-IV",
        .before = 1
      ),
    vas_ancova_summary |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "VAS",
        .before = 1
      ),
    vabs_raw_stnd_only |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "Vineland",
        .before = 1
      ),
    biomarker_ancova_summary |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "Biomarkers",
        .before = 1
      ),
    tlbx_ancova_summary |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "Toolbox",
        .before = 1
      ),
    eye_ancova_z_summary |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "Eye Tracking",
        .before = 1
      )
) |> 
  flextable::as_grouped_data(groups = "Instrument") |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    Outcome = ifelse(
      is.na(Outcome),
      Instrument,
      Outcome
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: additional-demog-tables
#| include: false
#| echo: false

# merge data, toolbox data, and eye-tracking data #
data_full <- data |> 
  # toolbox data
  dplyr::left_join(
    x = _,
    y = tlbx_ancova_data |> 
      dplyr::select(
        fxs_sts_id, redcap_event_name, dplyr::all_of(tlbx_var)
      ),
    by = c("fxs_sts_id", "redcap_event_name")
  ) |> 
  # create Visit for eye-tracking join
  dplyr::mutate(
    Visit = dplyr::case_when(
      redcap_event_name == "Baseline Visit (Visit 1)" ~ 1,
      redcap_event_name == "Week 16 (Visit 3/Early Term)" ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) |> 
  # eye-tracking
  dplyr::left_join(
    x = _,
    y = eye_ancova_zscore_data |> 
      dplyr::select(fxs_sts_id, Visit, dplyr::all_of(eye_zscore_var)),
    by = c("fxs_sts_id", "Visit")
  )

## secondary ##
demographic_variables <- c(
  "demo_age", "sex", "Race", "Ethnicity", "weight_kg",
  "leit3_nv_iq", "cgis_soi_fct", "Molecular.Category"
)

demographic_labels <- list(
  "demo_age" = "Age (years)",
  "sex" = "Sex",
  "Race" = "Race",
  "Ethnicity" = "Ethnicity",
  "weight_kg" = "Weight (kg)",
  "leit3_nv_iq" = "IQ",
  "cgis_soi_fct" = "CGIS Severity of Illness",
  "Molecular.Category" = "Molecular Category"
)

secondary_var <- c(
  # bmi
  "bmi",
  # abc
  "abc_comp_rev", "ss_i_irrit_rev", "ss_ii_leth_rev", "ss_iii_stereo_rev",
  "ss_iv_hyper_rev", "ss_v_inapp_rev", "ss_vi_socavoid_rev",
  # adams
  "adams_manic", "adams_depress", "adams_avoid", "adams_anxious", 
  "adams_obsess",
  # pedsql
  "pql_pf_tot", "pql_ef_tot", "pql_socf_tot", "pql_schf_tot",
  # cshq
  "cshq_ts",
  # snap
  "snap_adhd_combtot", "snap_odd_tot",
  # vas
  "vas_tb1_beh", "vas_tb2_lang", "vas_tb3_eat",
  # vabs
  "vabs3_rc_ss", "vabs3_ec_rs", "vabs3_wc_rs", "vabs3_pd_rs", "vabs3_dd_rs", 
  "vabs3_cd_rs", "vabs3_is_rs", "vabs3_ps_rs", "vabs3_cs_rs",
  "vabs3_ac_ss", "vabs3_c_ss", "vabs3_dl_ss", "vabs3_s_ss",
  # toolbox
  "tcb_read_analytic", "tcb_vocb_analytic", "tcb_ptrncomp_analytic",
  "tcb_dccs_analytic", "tcb_flnkr_analytic", "tcb_picseq_analytic",
  "tcb_lstsrt_analytic", "tcb_crystl_analytic",
  # eye-tracking
  "All_Face_Pct_vP_z", "Eyes_zscore", "Nose_zscore", "Mouth_zscore"
)

demog_tbls_ancova_secondary <- summarize_demographics_ancova(
  dataset = data_full,
  outcome_vars = secondary_var,
  demo_vars = demographic_variables,
  demo_labels = demographic_labels,
  age_stratify = TRUE,
  demo_age_var = "demo_age"
)

demog_secondary_merged_ft <- demog_tbls_ancova_secondary$merged |>
  gtsummary::as_flex_table() |>
  flextable::width(width = demog_tbl_width)

## biomarkers ##
demog_tbls_ancova_biomarker <- summarize_demographics_ancova(
  dataset = biomarker_data,
  outcome_vars = biomarker_var,
  demo_vars = demographic_variables,
  demo_labels = demographic_labels,
  age_stratify = TRUE,
  demo_age_var = "demo_age"
)

demog_biomarker_merged_ft <- demog_tbls_ancova_biomarker$merged |>
  gtsummary::as_flex_table() |>
  flextable::width(width = demog_tbl_width)
```


```{r}
#| label: export-tables
#| echo: false

strata <- "all_data"

# Create workbook

# Add each ANCOVA table as a separate sheet with flextable formatting
wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "Demographics")

  wb, sheet = "Demographics", ft = demog_merged_ft, 
  start_col = 3, start_row = 3
)
wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "Demographics Secondary")

  wb, sheet = "Demographics Secondary", ft = demog_secondary_merged_ft, 
  start_col = 3, start_row = 3
)
wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "Demographics Biomarker")

  ELS = els_ancova_summary,
```
